Mod.Name: Off the Books: Probably a Farm Story Tweaks
Mod.Author: RnK Gaming
Mod.Description: Probably a Farm Story's machines at Dr. Jackson and the Hypertech Smuggler get a chance per machine and visit instead of 100%: 25% while you own none, 5% once you own one (adjustable in the mod settings). This changes which machines the two sellers offer; it writes nothing to saves. Research requirements are kept, and the Integrated Farm and the perfume manual are unchanged. Requires Probably a Farm Story.
